description: Animol is using a small molecule discovery platform to find safer and more effective animal health drugs, with a data high ground of proprietary access to billions of compound-target interactions overlaid with a generative AI model.

Berkeley Yeast is a synthetic biology company engineering new flavors and functions for fermented beverages (including the world’s best non-alcoholic beer), with a data high ground of proprietary datasets from biochemical pathway screening.

Bruviti is an agentic AI company that predicts, detects, and resolves complex equipment service issues faster, with a data high ground of a part prediction model trained on technical repair manuals and customer service data

CIME has created a high-throughput platform for making complex molecules thousands of times faster than state-of-the-art, with a data high ground of a Build-Test-Learn inference engine that compounds chemical knowledge with every experiment.
Citrine is making materials chemistry innovation faster and better, with a data high ground of an AI operating system built upon the universe of known chemical and materials knowledge.
ClimateAI is safeguarding global supply chains, with a data high ground of the world’s most comprehensive proprietary climate dataset translated into forward-looking enterprise risk intelligence.

Drip Capital is energizing import/export financing between India and the USA, with a data high ground of novel trade credit and marketplace data that creates proprietary risk models unavailable to traditional lenders.
Enko is finding new sustainable and safe agricultural chemicals, with a data high ground of DNA-encoded libraries and AI-generated chemical interactomes spanning trillions of compound combinations.
Good Eggs is delivering the best and freshest grocery experience, with a data high ground of rich customer taste and ordering data curated through a highly differentiated product selection.

Immuto Scientific derives native-state protein structures at amino acid resolution for any protein or peptide in weeks, with a data high ground of the world’s most powerful surface protein folding model producing a novel oncology pipeline.

MarketDial is helping retailers comprehensively test and optimize their business initiatives, with a data high ground of a proprietary data-driven decision-making platform built on the largest repository of retail test-and-control experiments.

Matterworks has built the first large spectral model to automate the interpretation and quantification of mass spectrometry results, with a data high ground of first- and best-in-class proprietary and latent mass spectrometry scans.

ProducePay is delivering working capital to developing agricultural markets, with a data high ground of farm-level supply chain data and novel credit ratings unavailable through traditional financial channels.

Scentian Bio is building diagnostic tools with groundbreaking sensitivity, with a data high ground of a proprietary dataset mapping protein-chemical interactions across a vast library of odorant receptor responses.

Tess AI is an AI orchestration platform that acts as a general contractor for the enterprise AI workforce, with a data high ground of a proprietary Context Moat built across model, user, and organizational interactions.

Tovala is changing mealtime with their connected oven and fresh meal service, with a data high ground of a closed-loop data stream from oven usage telemetry that yields unique consumer taste and ordering insights.
Tribal AI uses AI agents to deliver trusted enterprise applications grounded in existing systems, with a data high ground of a proprietary ontology of cross-system metadata, starting with Salesforce.
